test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below. While the first (1) and the last(6) sentences are in the correct order, the sentences in between(A-D) are jumbled up. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

1. Nicholas Chorier is not a usual photographer.

A. He uses a kite to hoist his camera into the skies and clicks photographs while the camera dangles mid–air.

B. He is a kite aerial photographer.

C. Fascinated, he literally tied his two hobbies ,kite flying and photography ,together for a living.

D. During a trip to India to make a photo report on kite making, he learnt about this unique style of photography.

6. Today he is one of the most well–known kite aerial photographers in the world.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sentence **1 introduces Nicholas Chorier as an unusual photographer.**
 
• Sentence** B immediately follows **the introduction by specifying that he is a kite aerial photographer.
 
• Sentence **A gives** more detail about his method of using a kite to hoist his camera and take photographs.
 
• Sentence **D explains** how Chorier learned about this unique photography style during a trip to India.
 
• Sentence **C then describes** how he combined his hobbies of kite flying and photography to make a living.
 
• Sentence **6 concludes** by noting his renowned status as a kite aerial photographer.

Hence, the correct order is **BADC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When arranging jumbled sentences, look for logical connections and transitions between ideas to maintain coherence in the paragraph.
 
• Ensure each subsequent sentence builds on the information provided in the preceding sentence to create a seamless narrative.
